description: Self-test for the visual-scenario harness, the gate that proves T02's step types work before any T## task relies on them. (1) A frame diffed against itself reads exactly 0.0%. (2) Falsifiability: a full-frame black probe (CanvasLayer 1024, above every UI layer) vs the same probe turned white reads > 95% on the whole frame and on the full_viewport region, so a pixel_diff that stopped seeing differences fails here instead of passing every expect_max bound silently. (3) The probe is freed and the frame returns to its pre-probe state (T02_before vs T02_after <= 5%). Also exercises execute_script bounds and asserts the baseline file is well-formed.

steps.script:
var probe := CanvasLayer.new()
probe.name = "T02DiffProbe"
probe.layer = 1024
var fill := ColorRect.new()
fill.name = "Fill"
fill.color = Color(0, 0, 0, 1)
fill.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
fill.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
probe.add_child(fill)
tree.root.add_child(probe)
return fill.color.to_html(true)
